title: LHDS PDP decision input
description: Reconciled with the W1-4 token-claims contract lhds-at/1 (docs/fiab/health/security.md section A7/A8, PR #5127). The PDP verifies the AS-signed token itself (ES384 against data.lhds.config.jwks) and reads claims from the verified payload, so the interceptor passes the RAW token, never pre-parsed claims. Request-side fields are the interceptor contract owned by W1-5; items marked PROVISIONAL are not yet confirmed by any interceptor implementation (W2-3, W3-3).

access_token.description: Raw compact JWT: typ at+jwt, alg ES384, lhds_ver lhds-at/1. Claims checked: iss, aud (single string), exp, iat, jti, lhds_ver, tenant, sub, sub_type, client_id, scope (v2 form), lhds_roles, lhds_map_ver, pou, patient (patient/ scopes), idp_tid (user). act or cnf present = deny. pou BTG = deny (W1). Any missing claim = deny.

interaction.description: fhir: read|vread|history|search|create|update|patch|delete|operation. dicom: wado|qido|stow|delete. Keys of data.lhds.interactions.

tenant.description: Tenant slug resolved from the URL or host by the interceptor, never from the body. Compared to the tenant claim exactly (no case-folding or trimming).

base.description: Base URL of the request as received (the audience the token must name). Must be one of the tenant's bases in data.lhds.stamp.

resource_type.description: fhir only, required: FHIR resource type of the target.

op.description: fhir interaction=operation only: e.g. $export. Gated by lhds_roles via the role-scope map.

patient_compartment.description: PROVISIONAL (engine-resolved, ADR-011): patient ids owning the target, or the patients a search is bound to. Required non-empty for patient/ scopes; empty means unbound and denies. Every owner must equal the token patient.

categories.description: PROVISIONAL: category values the search carries (search) or the resource has (read), for category-constrained scopes. Compared by exact string to the scope constraint value; system|code vs bare code forms are NOT normalised.
